answer_1.quote: We did experiments on five commonly-researched natural language generation tasks as follows: Reading comprehension, dialogue summarization, style transfer, question generation and news summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs include answers, summaries, style-transferred text, and questions.

answer_2.quote: The generated answers are evaluated by BLEU scores widely used for QA systems, together with Meteor and Rouge-L F1.

answer_4.quote: To further prove the improvement of our approach, we asked three proficient English speakers from Asia for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: 100 samples from the test set of each task are randomly selected... 3-point Likert Scale is adopted for scoring each generation, where [5, 3, 1] represent excellent, moderate and disappointing results respectively.
